name: Solar Me
old_description: Since 2014, Solar Me has helped thousands of homeowners and businesses unlock the benefits of solar — not just with great installs, but with expert service, repairs, and support that lasts. We’re known for clean designs, smart recommendations, and honest answers — whether you’re going solar for the first time or need help with a system someone else installed.
about:
Solar Me was founded in 2014 in Jamesburg, New Jersey, as a small business with the goal of making sustainable energy more accessible to New Jersey residents and businesses. The company was built on the expertise of local solar consultants and homeowners, though the founder is not named in public materials.

The firm provides a full range of solar services including new system installations, diagnostics and repair, orphan system takeover, panel removal and decommissioning, critter and pest damage repair, and battery backup installation. It also offers commercial solar solutions for offices, retail spaces, and multifamily complexes, along with SREC management and system design. As of the latest figures, Solar Me has completed over 1,100 projects in New Jersey and installed more than 12 MW of solar capacity across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and New York.

The company serves both residential and commercial customers. Residential work includes installations in towns such as Boonton, Rumson, Watchung, South Brunswick, Vineland, Bernardsville, and Hamilton. Commercial clients include office buildings, retail centers, and multifamily properties. Solar Me also acts as a long-term service partner for systems originally installed by other companies that have gone out of business.

Solar Me was started with the dream of creating a more renewable future and emphasizes honest answers, clean designs, and smart recommendations. The company highlights its Tesla Energy Certified Installer status and NABCEP certification as markers of technical competence, and it differentiates itself by taking over orphaned systems and restoring monitoring without requiring the original installer.
